title: 2x Mustard Mizuna Plug Plants – Salad / Stir-Fry Greens - Hardy
description:
Mustard Mizuna produces an abundance of

 deeply cut, feathery lime-green leaves

with a

 mild, slightly spicy flavour

. It is

 easy to grow, highly resistant to bolting

, and continues to produce for many weeks with re-growth after cutting. Excellent for salads, stir-fries, or cooking.

 Product Details:

   Type:
  
  Mustard Mizuna (Brassica rapa var. nipposinica)
 

   Supplied As:
  
  2x plug plants
 

   Flavour:
  
  Mild, slightly spicy
 

   Harvest:
  
  Baby leaves in ~21 days, mature leaves in ~40 days
 

   Uses:
  
  Salads, stir-fries, cooking greens
 

 Growing Information:

   Sowing/Planting Months:
  
  Early spring through autumn
 

   Planting Depth:
  
  ¼ inch
 

   Spacing:
  
  6 inches between plants, 18 inches between rows
 

   Light:
  
  Full sun
 

   Watering:
  
  Keep soil moderately moist during germination and growth
 

 Tips:

  Sow/plant every 2–4 weeks for a continuous harvest.
 

  Thin gradually to 6 inches apart; thinnings can be eaten in salads.
 

  Harvest outer leaves young for best flavour, leaving inner leaves to keep growing.
 

  Very reliable and productive, even in warmer weather.
